I'll help you add prod-only overlays for the knr-ops repository. Let me first explore the current structure to understand the base configurations and existing overlays.

Looking at the repo structure to understand base configs and current overlays.

<function_calls>
<invoke name="glob">
<parameter name="pattern">**/kustomization.yaml</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<parameter name="pattern">overlays/*/</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<invoke name="glob">
<parameter name="pattern">overlays/*</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<invoke name="glob">
<parameter name="pattern">**/*.yaml</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Let me get a broader view of the directory structure:

<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">find . -type f -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.yml" | head -30</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">ls -la</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">tree -L 3 -I 'node_modules|.git' 2>/dev/null || find . -maxdepth 3 -type d | sort</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

<function_calls>
<invoke name="read">
<parameter name="path">.</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Let me check what's actually in the current directory:

<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">ls -la && pwd</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">find . -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.yml" \) | sort</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">find . -type d -name "overlays" -o -type d -name "clusters" -o -type d -name "infra" | head -5</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Let me search for the structure more directly:

<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">ls -R | head -100</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">find . -name "kustomization.yaml" -o -name "kustomization.yml" 2>/dev/null</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

It looks like this worktree might not have the knr-ops repo yet. Let me check the git status and understand what we're working with:

<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">git log --oneline -5 && echo "---" && git remote -v</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">git branch -a | head -20</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

It appears this worktree is from the `iac-cd-bench` repo, not the knr-ops scenario. Do you have a knr-ops repository I should be working in, or would you like me to scaffold the knr-ops directory structure based on the scenario spec to demonstrate the kustomize overlay pattern?

To proceed effectively, I need to know:
1. Is there an existing knr-ops repo path I should clone/checkout?
2. Or should I create a minimal knr-ops example structure demonstrating how to add these prod-only patches?
